description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor' that extends 'AbstractStreamingActor'. It provides functionality for streaming persisted entity data within a specified time window, utilizing MongoDB for data access. The class includes constructors, lifecycle management, and methods for creating data streams based on command parameters.

classes.name: AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor
classes.description: An abstract class for streaming persisted entity data within a time window, parameterized by entity type T extending EntityIdWithRevision.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Closes the MongoDB client connection when the actor stops.

methods.name: getElementClass
methods.description: Abstract method to get the class type of the entity elements.

methods.name: getCommandClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the command, SudoStreamPids.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Retrieves the burst size from the command.

methods.name: getInitialTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the initial timeout duration from the command.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the idle timeout duration from the command.

methods.name: batchMessages
methods.description: Batches a list of entities into a BatchedEntityIdWithRevisions object.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates an Akka Source stream of entities based on the command parameters, resuming from a lower bound if specified.

methods.name: mapEntity
methods.description: Maps a PidWithSeqNr to an entity of type T using the entityMapper function.
